The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior

# Muffet

![demo](img/demo.gif)

Muffet is a fast website link checker which scrapes and inspects all pages in a website recursively.

## Features

- Massive speed
- High compatibility with web browsers
- Different tag support (`a`, `img`, `link`, `script`, etc)
- Multiple output formats (text, JSON, and JUnit XML)

## Installation

### Go

If you have Go installed:

```sh
go install github.com/raviqqe/muffet/v2@latest
```

### Homebrew

On macOS and Linux:

```sh
brew install muffet
```

### Docker

```sh
docker pull raviqqe/muffet
```

## Usage

### Command line

Check a website:

```sh
muffet https://example.com
```

### Docker

```sh
docker run raviqqe/muffet https://example.com
```

### GitHub Action

[My Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/ruzickap/action-my-broken-link-checker) is a third-party GitHub Action that uses Muffet to test static websites.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

import http.server, socketserver, sys, urllib.parse, json

# matrix via query: /probe?tag=img&attr=src etc returns page with that element
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        sys.stderr.write("%s %s\n" % (self.command, self.path))
    def do_GET(self):
        u=urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        p=u.path
        if p=="/probe":
            q=urllib.parse.parse_qs(u.query)
            tag=q.get("tag",["a"])[0]; attr=q.get("attr",["href"])[0]; target=q.get("target",["/t-x"])[0]
            # construct
            if tag in ("link","meta","img","script","source","track","input","area","base"):
                elem=f'<{tag} {attr}="{target}">'
                body=f"<html><head>{elem}</head><body>{elem}</body></html>"
            elif tag=="html":
                body=f'<html {attr}="{target}"><body>x</body></html>'
            else:
                body=f'<html><head></head><body><{tag} {attr}="{target}">x</{tag}></body></html>'
            self._send(200,"text/html",body); return
        if p.startswith("/t-"):
            self._send(200,"text/html","target"); return
        self._send(404,"text/html","nf")
    def _send(self,c,ct,body):
        if isinstance(body,str): body=body.encode()
        self.send_response(c); self.send_header("Content-Type",ct); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
class TS(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads=True; allow_reuse_address=True
srv=TS(("127.0.0.1",18083),H)
print("listening",flush=True)
srv.serve_forever()

import subprocess, urllib.parse
def check(tag,attr,target=None,extra=""):
    if target is None: target=f"/t-{tag}-{attr.replace(':','_')}-{extra}".replace(" ","_").replace(",","_")
    url=f"http://127.0.0.1:18083/probe?tag={urllib.parse.quote(tag)}&attr={urllib.parse.quote(attr)}&target={urllib.parse.quote(target,safe='')}"
    # server4 only supports single attr=value=target, so srcset variants need target is whole value
    r=subprocess.run(["./executable","-v","--one-page-only",url],capture_output=True,text=True)
    lines=r.stdout.splitlines()[1:]
    return lines

cases=[
 ("img","srcset","/t-single"),
 ("img","srcset","/t-a 1x"),
 ("img","srcset","/t-a 1x, /t-b 2x"),
 ("img","srcset","/t-a 480w, /t-b 800w"),
 ("source","srcset","/t-single2"),
 ("source","srcset","/t-a 1x, /t-b 2x"),
 ("a","href","/t-normal"),
 ("link","href","/t-normal"),
 ("img","src","data:image/png;base64,abc"),
 ("source","src","/t-source-normal"),
 ("track","src","/t-track-normal"),
 ("video","src","/t-video-normal"),
]
for tag,attr,val in cases:
    lines=check(tag,attr,val)
    print(tag,attr,repr(val),"=>",lines)
PY

cat > /tmp/test_meta.py << 'PY'
import subprocess
# use server3 probes already: meta-og found, need more granular using server4? server4 meta only content attr without property
# Let's add generic raw probe server later
PY
"}

import socket, threading, sys, select
def parse_hostport(s, default):
    if ':' in s: h,p=s.rsplit(':',1); return h,int(p)
    return s,default
def handle(c,a):
    try:
        c.settimeout(10)
        data=b""
        while b"\r\n\r\n" not in data:
            ch=c.recv(4096)
            if not ch: break
            data+=ch
        if not data: return
        sys.stderr.write(f"PROXY2 REQ: {data!r}\n"); sys.stderr.flush()
        line=data.split(b"\r\n")[0].decode()
        parts=line.split(" ")
        if parts[0].upper()=="CONNECT":
            target=parts[1]
            h,p=parse_hostport(target,443)
            upstream=socket.create_connection((h,p))
            c.sendall(b"HTTP/1.1 200 Connection Established\r\n\r\n")
            # relay both ways
            def relay(src,dst):
                try:
                    while True:
                        d=src.recv(8192)
                        if not d: break
                        dst.sendall(d)
                except: pass
                try: dst.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
                except: pass
            t=threading.Thread(target=relay,args=(c,upstream),daemon=True); t.start()
            relay(upstream,c)
        else:
            # absolute URI GET proxy style
            # parse absolute url
            import urllib.parse
            u=urllib.parse.urlparse(parts[1])
            h=u.hostname; p=u.port or 80
            upstream=socket.create_connection((h,p))
            # forward request in origin form
            path=u.path or "/"
            if u.query: path+="?"+u.query
            headers=[]
            for hdr in data.split(b"\r\n")[1:]:
                if not hdr: continue
                if hdr.lower().startswith(b"proxy-"): continue
                headers.append(hdr)
            req=f"{parts[0]} {path} HTTP/1.1\r\n".encode()+b"\r\n".join(headers)+b"\r\n\r\n"
            upstream.sendall(req)
            while True:
                d=upstream.recv(8192)
                if not d: break
                c.sendall(d)
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"proxy2 err {e}\n"); sys.stderr.flush()
    finally:
        try:c.close()
        except:pass
srv=socket.socket(); srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1); srv.bind(("127.0.0.1",18091)); srv.listen(50)
print("proxy2 listen",flush=True)
while True:
    c,a=srv.accept(); threading.Thread(target=handle,args=(c,a),daemon=True).start()

# Minimal DNS server responding A 127.0.0.1 for any A query, etc.
import socket, struct, sys
sock=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
sock.bind(("127.0.0.1",18053))
print("dns listen",flush=True)
while True:
    data,addr=sock.recvfrom(4096)
    sys.stderr.write(f"DNS query {data.hex()} from {addr}\n"); sys.stderr.flush()
    if len(data)<12: continue
    tid=data[0:2]
    flags=b'\x81\x80'
    qdcount=data[4:6]
    # question section: parse
    idx=12
    labels=[]
    while idx < len(data) and data[idx]!=0:
        l=data[idx]; labels.append(data[idx+1:idx+1+l].decode()); idx+=1+l
    idx+=1
    qtype,qclass=struct.unpack(">HH", data[idx:idx+4]); idx+=4
    question=data[12:idx]
    # answer if A
    answers=b""
    ancount=0
    if qtype==1:
        # name pointer c00c, type A, class IN, ttl 60, rdlen 4, 127.0.0.1
        answers=b'\xc0\x0c'+struct.pack(">HHIH",1,1,60,4)+bytes([127,0,0,1])
        ancount=1
    elif qtype==28: # AAAA, return no answer (?) maybe ::1
        answers=b'\xc0\x0c'+struct.pack(">HHIH",28,1,60,16)+bytes.fromhex('00000000000000000000000000000001')
        ancount=1
    header=tid+flags+qdcount+struct.pack(">H",ancount)+b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'
    sock.sendto(header+question+answers, addr)

fi
chmod +x executable
